title: Priority (REMOVED in contract v2 — v1 tombstone, DO NOT IMPLEMENT)
description: REMOVED IN CONTRACT v2 (owner ruling 2026-07-28/29). The single global spend order was a product-model error: ordering is a CONSUMPTION property, so it now lives per agent backend in agent-supply.schema.json → `sources` {policy, order}. Nothing in v2 reads or writes this shape, and `PUT /api/models/priority` is gone from api.md. This file survives only as a v1 tombstone: the shipped-but-dormant v1 code still emits this payload and tests/test_model_hub_api.py still validates against it, so deleting the file today turns CI red for a shape v2 does not use. The lane that removes the endpoint and ModelHubConfig.priority_order deletes this file in the same PR and replaces that one assertion with an inline shape check. Text below is frozen v1 and must not be extended.

order.description: v1 only: source ids, position 0 = spend first; MUST contain every non-deleted source exactly once. v2's replacement is a per-backend SUBSET, not a permutation.
